comingSoon.title: Coming soon
comingSoon.message: This screen comes with a later work package.

portalHome.title: Welcome to the portal
portalHome.message: Request forms come with a later work package.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.passwordChanged: Your password has been changed. Sign in with the new one.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password
forgotPassword.intro: Enter the email of your account: you will receive a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sent: If an account matches {{ email }}, an email with a link is on its way. The link is valid for one hour.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.intro: At least 12 characters. A long sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.
resetPassword.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Ask for a new one.

verify.title: Two-step verification
verify.intro: Enter the 6-digit code shown by your authenticator app.
verify.backupIntro: Enter one of the backup codes you kept when enabling two-step verification. Each one works once.

enroll.title: Enable two-step verification
enroll.intro: Your organization requires two-step verification: set it up to continue.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.intro: Protect your account: after your password, you will enter a code from an authenticator app (Microsoft Authenticator, Google Authenticator, FreeOTP…).
mfa.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code to scan with your authenticator app; the key below gives the same information.
mfa.key: Or enter this key in the app:
mfa.codeHint: Shown by the app, renewed every 30 seconds
mfa.backupCodesIntro: Keep these backup codes somewhere safe: if you lose your phone, each one replaces a code from the app once. They will not be shown again.
mfa.fileTitle: My Little Big Project Planner backup codes
mfa.active: Two-step verification is enabled. Backup codes left: {{ count }}.
mfa.requiredByPolicy: Your organization requires it: it cannot be disabled.
mfa.disableIntro: To disable it, enter a code from the app or a backup code.

acceptInvitation.title: Join an organization
acceptInvitation.missingToken: This invitation link is incomplete. Open the link of the email again.
acceptInvitation.intro: {{ inviter }} invites you to join {{ tenant }}.
acceptInvitation.introNoInviter: You are invited to join {{ tenant }}.
acceptInvitation.existingAccount: You already have an account with this email: accepting adds {{ tenant }} to your organizations. Your password stays the same.
acceptInvitation.external: Your account is ready. You will reach {{ tenant }} through its request portal.
acceptInvitation.sso: You joined {{ tenant }}. It signs you in through its identity provider.

auth.providersIntro: Entra ID, Google, Okta, Keycloak… Members sign in with the provider account whose verified email is theirs. SAML and LDAP directories go through Keycloak.
auth.noProvider: No identity provider yet: members sign in with their password.

internalAccountsRequireSso.label: Internal accounts sign in through the identity provider
internalAccountsRequireSso.hint: Except the members marked as local accounts (contractors outside the directory).

localAccountsRequireMfa.label: Local accounts need two-step verification
localAccountsRequireMfa.hint: Members signing in with a password enable it at their next sign-in.

portalPasswordEnabled.label: Portal: sign-in with a password
portalPasswordEnabled.hint: For the external accounts of the request portal.

portalMagicLinkEnabled.label: Portal: sign-in with a link sent by email
portalMagicLinkEnabled.hint: For the external accounts of the request portal.

auth.ssoWithoutProvider: No identity provider is enabled: the rule applies once one is.
auth.clientSecretKeep: Leave empty to keep the stored secret
auth.emailClaimHint: email (verified by the provider), or a directory claim such as upn
auth.redirectUri: Redirect URI to register at the provider:

members.caption: Members and pending invitations of the organization
members.emptyHint: Change the search or the filters, or invite someone.
members.removeMessage: {{ name }} loses access to this organization at once and leaves its groups. Their account and their other organizations stay.
members.revokeMessage: The link sent to {{ email }} will stop working.
members.removed: {{ name }} was removed from the organization.

invite.title: Invite a member
invite.internalHint: Uses the application of the organization.
invite.externalHint: A customer or supplier: uses the request portal only.

member.title: Access of {{ name }}
member.localAccountHint: Signs in with a password even when the organization requires its identity provider (people outside its directory).

groups.intro: Groups let you grant roles to several members at once.
groups.caption: Groups of the organization
groups.emptyHint: Create a group, then add members to it.
groups.deleteMessage: The group goes; its members stay in the organization.
groups.name: Name
groups.noMember: No member in this group yet.

errors.not_found: This item does not exist or is no longer available.
errors.method_not_allowed: This action is not possible on this item.
errors.request_timeout: The server took too long to answer. Try again.
errors.conflict: This action conflicts with the current state.
errors.precondition_failed: Someone changed this item in the meantime. Reload it before trying again.
errors.payload_too_large: The data sent is too large.
errors.unsupported_media_type: This data format is not accepted.
errors.precondition_required: Reload the item before changing it.
errors.internal: The server ran into an error. Try again later.
errors.too_many_requests: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.

csrf.invalid: Your session could not be verified. Reload the page and try again.

auth.reset_token_invalid: This link is invalid, has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
auth.sso_required: Your organization signs you in through its identity provider: use the button above.
auth.oidc_failed: Sign-in through the identity provider failed. Try again.
auth.oidc_no_member: No member of this organization has the email of this account.
auth.oidc_email_unverified: The identity provider does not confirm the email of this account.
auth.switch_failed: This switch link is invalid, has expired or was already used. Sign in again.

oidc_provider.duplicate: This identity provider is already configured.
oidc_provider.unreachable: The identity provider cannot be reached or answered badly.

idempotency_key.reused: This request was already sent with different data.
idempotency_key.in_flight: This request is already being processed.

tenant.slug_taken: Another organization already uses this identifier.
tenant.confirmation_mismatch: Type the identifier of the organization to confirm its deletion.
tenant.delete_current: You cannot delete the organization you are signed in to.

errors.network: The server cannot be reached. Check your connection.

field.out_of_range: The value is out of the allowed range.
field.same_as_email: The password must differ from the email.
field.not_default_slug: In single-organization mode, only the configured identifier is allowed.
field.external_member_only: An external account cannot administer the organization.

invitation.invalid: This invitation link is invalid, has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
invitation.pending: This email already has a pending invitation: send it again instead.
invitation.already_member: This email already belongs to a member of the organization.
invitation.closed: This invitation was already accepted or revoked.

member.last_admin: The organization needs at least one active organization admin.

group.name_taken: Another group already has this name.
